reviews.review: This is my favorite game right now (and hopefully all time) not for just one thing, not three things, not eight things, but all the things. Everything about this game just hits perfectly. The music is wonderful, the art style is simple yet somehow beautiful, the gameplay is phenomenal. I've spent 40 hours on this game (which seeing most of the other players time its tiny) and I haven't lost a bit of interest in this game, in fact, I've gained more interest in this game the longer I've played it. There is a extreme amount of content in this game, there's always something to do, and if your tired of playing with people, play alone, it can be just as fun. I've only got one small problem with this game... and that's the fact it doesn't have crossplay. Not all my friends have PCs, so if I want to play with them, I'd have to repurchase the game on another console and lose my progress. If they do add crossplay, i feel like not only would more people buy it, it would become the best dwarven-extraction-mining-shooter on the market.
